entities.summary: Olumiye Dimolu "Miye" Oni is an American-Nigerian professional basketball player for the Indios de Mayagüez of the Baloncesto Superior Nacional (BSN) in Puerto Rico. He played college basketball for the Yale Bulldogs. He plays the shooting guard position. Oni was named Ivy League Player of the Year in 2019 and was a three-time All-Ivy League selection.
